title: Beautiful Kelowna Winery Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Dress code: wear weather appropriate clothing and closed-toe shoes
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a captivating full-day Kelowna Wine Tour, exploring the region’s top wineries. Experience world-class wines, picturesque landscapes, and enriching vineyard tours.

Experience the rich flavors and stunning landscapes of Kelowna’s wineries on this exceptional wine tour, where each stop offers a unique insight into the art of winemaking.

Please note:
-The venues on our tours may vary depending on availability.
-A minimum of 4 guests is required for public tours. If fewer than 4 people are booked, we may need to reschedule.
